statement: NVIDIA is itself an investor in the Nscale raise, committing $1 billion that converts into non-voting shares at IPO.
why: When the chip supplier helps fund its own customer, reported demand and supplier support become harder to separate.

impact.mechanism: Supplier participation in a customer's capital structure ties that customer's accelerator purchases partly to vendor financing rather than purely independent demand.

evidence.excerpt: plus an additional $1 billion commitment from NVIDIA expected to fund in mid-November 2026
The notes convert automatically into ordinary shares (or non-voting shares in NVIDIA's case) upon completion of Nscale's IPO.

confidence.basis: Company press release; no disclosure of any purchase commitments linked to the investment.

entity: Nscale Limited (AI neocloud); NVIDIA; Third Point; Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC (placement agent)
